gold_reason: Gold prices may rise as a safe-haven asset due to ongoing global uncertainties

lead_story: The US and Japan have taken joint action to prop up the yen, the US used most of its long-range precision missiles during the Iran war, and Fed officials are signaling potential rate hikes to address inflation, all of which are influencing the current macroeconomic landscape. The de-escalation of tensions with Iran is also causing oil prices to drop, which could have a positive impact on the stock market. Overall, these events are creating a complex and dynamic environment for investors to navigate.
